blocks.html:
Rock Bottom Full Truck Wrap

We here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto have been working throughout the holiday season to ensure our customers start the New Year with new marketing and branding on their vehicles. Rock Bottom asked us to do a full truck wrap on their latest purchase. This Hino truck is brand new, straight from the showroom, and it first job for Rock Bottom was to get wrapped.
This is one Christmas gift wrap that does not need to be unwrapped on the 25th December. Our installation crew worked at making sure all of the trucks curves and bumps were covered while the graphics remained tidy and clear. This is the 2nd vehicle we have done a full truck wrap on for Rock Bottom underpinning.com. We have also done another of their vehicles as a partial wrap and look forward to doing more in the future.

Installation and Completion Images

In the pictures above you can see one of our Vinyl Wrap Toronto crew preparing and attaching the window graphics. We take great care to measure and ensure the graphics are aesthetically pleasing. After a few last touches and cleaning we contact client to collect the vehicle.

We have more examples available of our work, partial and full wraps click here. If you would like to know more about Vinyl Wrapping your vehicle, Call us at 416-746-1381. Our in-house design team is more than willing to explain the ins and outs of Vinyl Wrapping.

Rock Bottom has already expressed interest in getting more of their new vehicles fully wrapped. Our dream here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto is to wrap more than a hundred cars in 2020. Follow us on Instagram and Like our Facebook page to keep up to date with our latest wraps.

Visit us at 24 Ronson Drive, Unit 1, Etobicoke, M9W 1B4. You can speak to our team who have between them 20 years of experience in the Vinyl Wrapping industry.
